name: cursor-bridge
description: MCP server: drive Cursor IDE's agent for semantic code search over CDP.

interface.shortDescription: Drive Cursor semantic search from Codex over CDP.
interface.longDescription: Expose cursor_search, cursor_status, and cursor_launch so Codex can ask Cursor IDE for project-aware semantic search through its agent, without console injection.
defaultPrompt: Use Cursor Bridge to search this project with Cursor's semantic agent.
Check whether Cursor Bridge can launch Cursor with CDP and report status.
